greeting: Hello! How can I help you today?
thanks: You're welcome! Is there anything else I can help you with?
ask_rephrase: Could you tell me a little more about what you need help with?
ask_order_id: Sure, I can help with that. What is your order number?
ask_phone: Thank you. To confirm that it is you, please send the phone number on the order.
ask_reason: What is the reason? A few words are enough.
ask_amount: What amount are you asking for?
ask_new_address: What is the new delivery address?
ask_description: Please describe the problem in a few words.
confirm_again: Please answer yes to go ahead or no to cancel.
disambiguate_intent: Do you want to {a} or {b}? You can say the first or the second.
identity_failed: I'm sorry, those details do not match our records. Could you check the phone number and send it again?
order_status_in_transit: Your order {order_id} is {status}. It is expected on {date}.
late_policy_note: It is {days} days past the expected date. This is what our policy says:
confirm_action_create_return: I can set up a return for order {order_id}. Shall I go ahead? (yes/no)
confirm_action_create_exchange: I can set up an exchange for order {order_id}. Shall I go ahead? (yes/no)
confirm_action_create_refund: I can refund EGP {amount} for order {order_id}. Shall I go ahead? (yes/no)
confirm_action_cancel_order: I can cancel order {order_id}. Shall I go ahead? (yes/no)
confirm_action_update_delivery_address: I can change the delivery address of order {order_id} to: {address}. Shall I go ahead? (yes/no)
confirm_action_apply_voucher: I can give you a voucher of EGP {amount} for order {order_id}. Shall I go ahead? (yes/no)
confirm_action_create_ticket: I can open a support ticket about order {order_id}. Shall I go ahead? (yes/no)
confirm_action_default: I can do this for you: {action}. Shall I go ahead? (yes/no)
action_cancelled: Okay, I won't do that. Is there anything else I can help with?
action_failed: Sorry, I could not complete that. Nothing was changed on your order.
policy_denied: I'm sorry, I can't do that under our policy.
approval_pending: This needs approval from our customer care team. I have sent them your request and a colleague will get back to you.
human_will_reply: A colleague will reply to you here shortly.
lookup_failed: I could not look that up right now. Please try again in a moment.
unsupported: I'm sorry, I can't do that here, but a colleague can.
out_of_scope: I can only help with your orders and our shop policies. Would you like to talk to a person?
dependency_down: Part of our system is not available right now, so I can't do that yet. Please try again shortly.
handoff_generic: I'm connecting you with a colleague who can help you with this.
handoff_customer_request: Of course. I'm connecting you with a colleague from our customer care team now.
handoff_mandatory_risk: I'm passing this to our customer care team right away so a colleague can look into it personally.
handoff_policy_denied: I can't go ahead with this one, but I'm passing it to a colleague who can look at your case.
handoff_approval_required: This needs approval from our customer care team, so I've passed your request to a colleague.
handoff_repeated_tool_failure: I could not get the information I need right now, so I'm connecting you with a colleague.
handoff_unverified_result: I could not confirm that this went through, so I will not say it is done. A colleague will check and get back to you.
handoff_no_evidence: I could not find a reliable answer to that, so I'm connecting you with a colleague who can help.
handoff_dependency_unavailable: Part of our system is not available right now, so I'm handing this to a colleague.
handoff_low_confidence: I'm having trouble understanding the request, so I'll connect you with a colleague who can help.
handoff_identity_failed: I could not verify your details, so for your security I'm connecting you with a colleague.
handoff_ownership_mismatch: I can't share details about that order here. I'm connecting you with a colleague who can check it with you.
handoff_high_frustration: I'm sorry for the trouble. I'm connecting you with a colleague right away to sort this out.
handoff_capability_missing: I can't do that myself yet, so I'm passing it to a colleague.
handoff_unsupported: That is something only a colleague can handle, so I'm connecting you now.
